findings.title: Unnecessary readonly modifier on type properties
findings.body: The `readonly` modifier on the properties of `CheckSummaryInput` is redundant because TypeScript's `Readonly<T>` or `Readonly<CheckSummaryInput>` is typically used at the usage site rather than on individual properties. This adds noise without additional safety since the type itself is not marked as readonly.

findings.title: Inconsistent property naming style in type definition
findings.body: The type `CheckSummaryInput` introduces `readonly` properties, which is a deviation from the existing style in this file where properties are not marked as readonly. The file previously defined properties without modifiers, so the new `readonly` modifier introduces an inconsistency.
